title: The Tabernacle Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Tabernacle Bible Crossword
description: Solve a tabernacle Bible crossword: shittim wood and the ark, the mercy seat, the golden candlestick, the veil and the shewbread. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Fifteen chapters of Exodus are given to a tent and its furniture, described twice over: once as instruction and once as it was made. The Tabernacle works through the whole plan — the ark of shittim wood overlaid with gold, the mercy seat and the cherubims, the table of shewbread, the golden candlestick, the veil, the laver, and the cloud that covered the tent when it was finished.

It is the most technical puzzle in the archive and the most satisfying to complete, because the KJV's vocabulary here is unlike anywhere else. The closing verse is the reason given for building it at all.

clues.text: Wood the ark was made of
Bread set in order before the LORD
The most holy place, behind the veil
Of the LORD, it filled the tabernacle

verseText: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
